name: fdeops
description: Skills for forward deployed engineers across strategy, architecture and engineering. Use individual tasks or @fde coordination; local customer memory supports continuity.

interface.longDescription: FDEOps helps forward deployed engineers frame customer problems, investigate workflows, compare approaches, plan delivery, evaluate AI behavior and prepare handoffs. Use its 35 task skills independently or the fde coordinator for ongoing work. Methods scale to the evidence, risk and time available. Skills work from permitted supplied context. Local engagement records require an authorized execution environment with Node.js, Git and persistent storage. This skills-only release has no hosted MCP service, automatic capture or built-in access to customer systems. Installation does not grant access or establish customer approval.
defaultPrompt: Help me reframe this customer brief before choosing a solution.
Turn these meeting notes into proposed decisions and next actions.
Plan the smallest useful delivery slice with observable acceptance checks.
